bias.en: Uptrend, momentum fading · MACD crossed down
bias.zh: 上升趋势、动能减弱 · MACD 下穿

read.en: Palantir fell 7.2% on Oct 16 to $186.03 on heavy volume, reversing from $203.55 to a low of $184.45. It is below its rising 5-day ($201.0) and 10-day ($198.9) averages and just under the rising 30-day ($186.4), and above the 100-day ($157.2) and 200-day ($152.7). MACD crossed below its signal on Oct 16 and is above zero, Parabolic SAR has been bearish since Oct 15 ($212.53), and RSI is 46.
read.zh: Palantir 10月16日自 $203.55 回落，盘中低见 $184.45，收盘放量下跌 7.2%，报 $186.03。股价位于上行的 5 日（$201.0）和 10 日均线（$198.9）下方，略低于上行的 30 日均线（$186.4），仍在 100 日（$157.2）和 200 日均线（$152.7）之上。MACD 于 10月16日下穿信号线，仍在零轴之上，抛物线 SAR 自 10月15日起看空（$212.53），RSI 为 46。

read.en: The $199.1 (10-day) and $193 supports both broke, and the close sits on the 30-day average. Resistance is $186.4 (30-day), then $192.6–194.7 (Oct 15 low, Sep 24 high) and $199–201 (10 and 5-day averages). Support is $184.5 (Oct 16 and Sep 29 lows), then $172 (Sep 18 low) and $164.6 (Sep 10 low). A close below $184.5 would open $172.
